Name: Vintage Interface v2 - Generic Mod Config Menu
Author: rustyasahalo
Description:
[u]Please Note:[/u] The original mod (Vintage Interface V2) now includes recolours of both GMCM buttons. I will keep this up but you can get the same result by using the files inside the "compat" folder included with Vintage Interface V2.

I was tired of the GMCM buttons not matching the UI so I recoloured them. 

[b]Installation:[/b]
Unzip, then copy and paste the "GenericModConfigMenu" folder into your Mods folder, let the files overwrite.
